title: Static-site Caddies serve AgentReady-compliant prerendered sites, with a narrow redeploy + verify
objective: Both loopback static-site Caddies (personal website, kcd2 dice solver) render one shared site-block body that serves the prerendered dist/ with real 404s and the ai-catalog Link header, gain a sudo-free `serve` redeploy, and redeploy_agent_ready_sites.sh redeploys and verifies the three public static sites with the AgentReady checker.
acceptance_criteria: e2e_agent_ready_caddy.sh website and dice: every assert passes and agent_ready url mode exits 0 against the rendered Caddyfile
Unknown paths return 404 with the site's 404 page, not the SPA shell with 200
`serve` refuses a missing dist/ before docker runs and recreates only that site's container
redeploy_agent_ready_sites.sh --verify-only prints one PASS/FAIL/UNDETERMINED line per site and exits 0 only when all pass
out_of_scope: Site content and build (personal-website, kcd2-dice-solver, signal-bot repos)
The shared edge Caddy, sudo/pacman steps and full setup rebuilds
